subject: PO schema enforcement vs flexible invoicing — Net45 with monthly sweep option
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@novacare.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Hi Karthik,

Quick procurement question as we prepare the PO for the pilot: our treasury requires a PO header with the following mandatory fields: PO number, vendor tax ID (EIN), legal entity name, cost center (BU code), and billing contact email. Can Redwood accept a single blanket PO referencing multiple invoices line-items, or do you require one PO per invoice?

Also — our standard terms are Net45 but our AP team runs a monthly sweep on the 7th. Would Redwood be able to align invoices to a monthly sweep cadence (invoices issued on the 1st of the month) while still keeping Net45 billing terms?

Finally, can you support splitting invoices by internal cost centers (we sometimes need separate invoices for different BU codes under the same PO)? Attaching our standard PO template.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Senior Procurement Manager
Novacare Health
Attachments: Novacare_PO_Template.pdf (PDF, 96KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@novacare.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:25:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Hi Liam — thanks for the detail and the template. Looping in Vanessa (billing ops) and Marissa (legal) so we can confirm. High level answers and a few options below:

1) PO header fields: we can consume the fields you listed. Our billing system requires the PO number to be mapped to the Redwood subscription ID (we'll provide a mapping file). Vendor tax ID / legal entity are fine — please ensure the legal name used on the PO matches the one on the invoice.

2) Single blanket PO vs one-per-invoice: we can accept one blanket PO for the engagement. Invoices can reference the same PO number; however, for ERP matching we need each invoice to include a line-level attribute "BU-Code" so your AP can auto-route. If Novacare prefers separate invoices per cost center we can do that as well — it's just an extra processing step on our side.

3) Net45 + monthly sweep: yes — we can issue invoices monthly on the 1st (or the next business day) and keep Net45 terms. That satisfies most treasury workflows. If you need invoices produced on a different day (eg the 7th sweep), we can shift the invoice date; just let us know which recurring day works best.

4) Net30 exception / accelerated payment: we can offer Net30 for invoices under $50,000 without additional fees. For enterprise-wide Net30 we typically apply a 1.5% processing surcharge to offset treasury timing.

Next steps: I attached a short "Billing Guidelines" doc that shows the exact invoice JSON/CSV field we need (PO, BU-Code, Subscription ID, Invoice Contact). I also attached a redline of the MSA showing recommended invoice wording. Vanessa — can you confirm the internal sequencing and whether we need to toggle any flags in our billing system to accept cost-center split invoices?

If Novacare can confirm the preferred invoice day and whether cost-center split invoices are required, I will produce a formal quote that includes both the Net45 default and the Net30/fee alternative for procurement to sign.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Billing_Guidelines.pdf (PDF, 48KB); MSA_redline.docx (DOCX, 120KB)
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@novacare.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@novacare.com>, Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 13:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Karthik — thanks for the fast reply and the attachments. Two quick clarifications from our side:

• Treasury prefers the monthly sweep to run on the 7th. If Redwood issues invoices on the 1st we can include them in that run, but if there's a hard requirement to align invoice date to the 7th we need that explicitly called out.
• For this pilot we'll need separate invoices per BU code (we use different cost centers for chargebacks). That said, if Redwood can produce one invoice with line-level BU codes that our ERP can auto-split, that's acceptable.

Please include both options in the formal quote: (A) Monthly invoice on the 1st + Net45 (default) and (B) Monthly invoice on the 7th + Net45 (explicit alignment). Also include the Net30 option and the 1.5% fee alternative so procurement has a clear cost comparison.

If you can get the quote over by end of day Monday, we can attach it to the PO approval packet.

Appreciate it —
Liam
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@novacare.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Thanks Liam — we can do both invoice-day options. Final proposal below (will put in a formal PDF quote and HubSpot deal record):

• Standard flow (no fee): Redwood will accept a single blanket PO for the engagement and issue monthly invoices referencing that PO number. Invoices will include line-level "BU-Code" and the Redwood Subscription ID for ERP matching. Invoice day: the 1st of each month (or next business day). Net45 payment terms.

• Treasury alignment (no fee): If you need invoice dates to be the 7th to match Novacare's AP sweep, we will schedule invoices on the 7th instead. Net45 terms remain unchanged.

• Accelerated terms option (Net30): For invoices under $50k, Net30 can be applied with no fee. For enterprise-wide Net30, a 1.5% processing surcharge will be added to invoice totals.

• Implementation notes: we will provide a mapping CSV that maps your PO numbers to Redwood Subscription IDs. For split-billing by cost center, we can either (A) emit separate invoices per BU code or (B) emit a single invoice with robust line-level BU-Code fields that your ERP will split. Option A will add one extra business day of processing on our end.

Next steps: I will upload a formal quote (Quote_DEAL-4821.pdf) to the HubSpot deal and share a DocuSign link for signature. Please confirm whether you prefer invoices on the 1st or the 7th, and whether you want separate invoice documents per BU code or a single multi-line invoice that your ERP will split.

If I don't hear back by Monday EOD we'll default to the 1st + single-invoice-with-line-BU (Net45) and produce the quote accordingly.

Regards,
Karthik
Head of Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Quote_DEAL-4821.pdf (PDF, 32KB)
